data.action: 白无垢十指相扣立神前，紫瞳认真含泪微笑
data.camera: wide shot, formal portrait, bride holding hands, shrine light, tender vow
data.description: 向来向死而行的虫柱，今天披上了纯白无垢。白角隐下的紫瞳认真得前所未有，她在神前与你十指相扣——「我这一生的剧毒，本该随我葬进夜里。……但如果是你，毒也会变成药。所以，请让我把余下的每一天，都用来对你温柔。」
data.promptProse: Shinobu stands at the shrine altar in a white bridal hood and wedding kimono. Facing her is a man with short dark hair in a formal black haori over gray-striped hakama. She interlaces her fingers with his and lifts her tearful purple eyes as morning light reaches their joined hands.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 白无垢的花嫁之誓
data.animaCaption: Shinobu looks up beneath the white bridal hood, her fingers linked with the short dark-haired groom's. He wears a formal black haori and striped gray hakama.
